title: AgentDropout: Dynamic Agent Elimination for Token-Efficient and High-Performance LLM-Based Multi-Agent Collaboration
authors: Zhexuan Wang; Yutong Wang; Xuebo Liu; Liang Ding; Miao Zhang; Jie Liu; Min Zhang
venue_full: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics 2025
affiliations: Institute of Computing and Intelligence, Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen (Zhexuan Wang, Yutong Wang, Xuebo Liu, Min Zhang);

problem_statement.en: LLM-based multi-agent systems suffer from low communication efficiency (redundant agents and messages inflate token cost) and suboptimal task performance because their communication topology is designed statically. The paper asks how to dynamically eliminate redundant agents and edges across communication rounds to improve both token efficiency and accuracy.
problem_statement.zh: 基於 LLM 的 multi-agent 系統存在通訊效率低落的問題(冗餘的 agent 與訊息會膨脹 token 成本),且因其通訊拓撲採用靜態設計而導致任務表現次佳。本文探討如何在跨通訊回合的過程中動態剔除冗餘的 agent 與邊,以同時提升 token 效率與準確率。

key_innovation.en: AgentDropout makes the per-round intra-round and inter-round adjacency matrices of the communication graph learnable (edges initialized at 0.5) and optimizes them offline via REINFORCE on 40 samples, then performs a two-stage pruning: NODE dropout removes agents with the smallest weighted in/out-degree sum per round (rate alpha), followed by EDGE dropout that keeps only the highest-weight (1-beta) fraction of edges under a nuclear-norm-regularized objective.
key_innovation.zh: AgentDropout 將通訊圖的各回合內(intra-round)與跨回合(inter-round)鄰接矩陣設為可學習(邊初始化為 0.5),並在 40 個樣本上以 REINFORCE 進行離線最佳化,隨後執行兩階段剪枝:NODE dropout 依比率 alpha 移除每回合中加權出入度總和最小的 agent,接著 EDGE dropout 在核範數(nuclear-norm)正則化的目標函數下僅保留權重最高的 (1-beta) 比例邊。

baselines_compared: Vanilla, Chain-of-Thought, MAS round=1, MAS round=T, AgentPrune

key_improvements.en: On Llama3-8B-Instruct, AgentDropout averages 68.70 across the six tasks vs AgentPrune 66.51 (+2.19) and full multi-round MAS (round=T); per-task: MMLU 62.75 (vs AgentPrune 60.78), GSM8K 73.13, AQuA 47.78, MultiArith 92.59, SVAMP 80.11, HumanEval 55.84. Gains hold across scales (Qwen2.5-72B, Deepseek-V3-671B). Abstract-level summary: vs SOTA, average reduction of 21.6% prompt tokens and 18.4% completion tokens with +1.14 average task performance.
key_improvements.zh: 在 Llama3-8B-Instruct 上,AgentDropout 於六項任務的平均得分為 68.70,優於 AgentPrune 的 66.51(+2.19)以及完整多回合 MAS(round=T);各任務表現為:MMLU 62.75(對比 AgentPrune 60.78)、GSM8K 73.13、AQuA 47.78、MultiArith 92.59、SVAMP 80.11、HumanEval 55.84。此增益在不同規模模型上皆成立(Qwen2.5-72B、Deepseek-V3-671B)。摘要層級總結:相較於 SOTA,平均減少 21.6% 的 prompt token 與 18.4% 的 completion token,同時平均任務表現提升 +1.14。Llama3 上的 token 計數(彙總):AgentDropout 為 3.3M prompt / 839K completion,對比 MAS round=T 的 4.7M / 1.0M(約 -30% prompt / 約 -16% completion)。

structure_space: Edge topology (spatial), Temporal / cross-round edges, Team composition (agent set)
decision_mechanism: Policy gradient / REINFORCE, Heuristic scoring / ranking
optimization_signal: Task utility (accuracy), Cost-aware utility, Validation-set score
benchmarks_used: MMLU, GSM8K, MultiArith, AQuA, SVAMP, HumanEval

agent_scenario.en: A single-domain LLM multi-agent collaboration: N homogeneous LLM agents arranged in a directed communication graph run for T rounds (T=2 for reasoning/math, T=4 for code). Agents exchange textual messages along graph edges; a final aggregation/decision produces the answer. AgentDropout modifies which agents participate and which edges carry messages in each round. No external tools are described beyond the LLM agents themselves; the graph optimization is offline and then fixed for inference.
agent_scenario.zh: 單一領域的 LLM multi-agent 協作情境:N 個同質的 LLM agent 排列於一個有向通訊圖中,執行 T 個回合(推理/數學任務 T=2,程式碼任務 T=4)。各 agent 沿圖的邊交換文字訊息;最終經由聚合/決策產生答案。AgentDropout 修改每個回合中參與的 agent 以及承載訊息的邊。除 LLM agent 本身外未描述任何外部工具;圖的最佳化為離線進行,並於推論階段固定。
